row.title: DEP-LOOP-1: bot-only dependency bumps need no write-back
row.body: Dependabot PR 1829 was blocked by writeback check, so DEP-LOOP-1 could never merge it. check() now skips the write-back requirement when every commit author is a GitHub bot.

title: DEP-LOOP-1: bot-only dependency bumps need no write-back
